# barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_policy (Resource)

Manages the organization's **default** LLM Gateway API key lifetime policy. It is a per-organization singleton, so this resource configures it rather than creating anything.

The policy limits how long API keys that users create for themselves (self-serve, from their own settings) may live. Keys created by admins are exempt. Existing keys keep their expiry: the policy is checked when a key is created or rotated.

Which policy applies to a user: their own `barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_user_override` if they have one; otherwise the strictest of their groups' `barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_group_override`s (the shortest maximum, and an expiry required if any requires one); otherwise the organization default (`barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_policy`). An override replaces what it overrides, so it can be longer or shorter, and one with no limits set exempts its group or user.

With no limits set (no `max_lifetime_days`, `require_expiry = false`) the organization has no default. `terraform destroy` clears the default the same way.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organization's default lifetime for API keys users create for
# themselves: every self-serve key gets exactly 60 days, and users don't pick
# an expiry. Keys created by admins are exempt. `terraform destroy` clears the
# default.
resource "barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_policy" "org" {
  max_lifetime_days = 60
  fixed_lifetime    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fixed_lifetime` (Boolean) Every key gets exactly `max_lifetime_days`, and users don't choose an expiry. Requires `max_lifetime_days`. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_lifetime_days` (Number) Longest a key may live, in days from when it is created or rotated (1-3650). A maximum also rules out keys that never expire. The platform allows a day of slack, so "the end of the last allowed day" fits in any time zone. Omit for no maximum.
- `require_expiry` (Boolean) Keys must have an expiry, even without a maximum. Implied by `max_lifetime_days`. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the policy; the API keys the default by the credential's organization, so this equals the provider's `organization_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The default is a per-organization singleton; import it by the organization
# ID the provider credential is scoped to.
terraform import barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_policy.org 1f4a8b2c-3d4e-4f5a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
```
